summary: Header.Item gains variant="quiet" (the site bar's item, #33): label-md, 32px, no fill in any state, ink as the only channel — --ui-text-muted at rest, --ui-text-primary on hover and when current (the inverse of the default item, whose current page recedes; a row already at muted has nowhere to recede to). Affixed, rest steps up to secondary for the same 3.66:1-in-dark reason the default current item does. Under a `data-over-media` attribute on the bar it takes the media inks. Header.MenuButton gains a TEXT form: given children it renders the word at label-md in a 44px target with no surface, its label required to start with that word (SC 2.5.3). The default variant and the glyph form are unchanged.
